transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

I’ve been having trouble keeping my mind on things like I used to. At work, I’ll sit with a loan worksheet or a client follow-up list and reread the same line over and over. Then I put off making calls because even simple decisions feel harder than they should.
Aside from the concentration issues, have you been feeling down, sad, or depressed lately?

Yes. Most days I feel this dull heaviness that doesn’t really go away. Even when I’m at the community center or out in my garden—things that used to make me feel better—I’m mostly just going through the motions, like I’ve got a smile on but don’t really feel it.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
It started after my close friend died, a little over two years ago. It’s been there ever since.
Before your friend passed away two years ago, had you ever experienced a period of feeling depressed like this?
I’m not sure. I don’t really remember having a stretch like this before then.
Over the past two years, has there been any period of two months or more where your mood completely lifted and you felt back to normal?
No, I haven’t had a stretch where I felt back to normal. It’s been there since my friend died, a little over two years ago.
How has your sleep been over these past two years?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to my sleep, I guess.
How have your energy levels been over this time?
My energy’s been pretty low. I wake up tired even after a full night of sleep, and after just a couple of client calls or watering the tomatoes, I feel like I’ve already done a whole day’s work.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite over these past two years?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really noticed any particular change in my appetite.
How have you been feeling about yourself over these past two years?
I’m not sure what you mean exactly. I haven’t really thought much about how I feel about myself.
During these past two years, have you found yourself feeling hopeless about the future?
I keep telling myself things might turn around, but underneath, I guess I feel like this is just how my life is going to be now—smaller and harder, no matter what I try.
